units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 13">Lev. R. s. 13</cite> [read:] <he>הדא חיותא כי סלקא מן ימא היא מ׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>ממכיא</he>) an animal coming on land from the water is timid, coming out of the forest, it is not; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 3:4:2">Cant. R. to III, 4</cite> (corr. acc.).

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 32:10">Gen. R. s. 32</cite> <he>אי מן מ׳ הוא</he> if it is one of the low mounts; (<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 4:4:4">Cant. R. to IV, 4</cite> <he>מַכִּיכַיָּא</he>, v. <cite ref="M01376">next w.</cite>).
